senses.gloss: ch. sameto trouble, stir up, keep in commotion.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 168b:8">B. Bath. 168ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו קא טַרְדֵּי ליה</he> they were troubling him (begging persistently).—Part. pass. <cite ref="I00776"><he>טָרִיד</he></cite>, f. <he>טְרִידָא</he>; pl. <he>טְרִידִין</he>, <he>טְרִידָן</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 57:20">Targ. Is. LVII, 20</cite> (h. text <he>נגרש</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Nahum 2:5">Targ. Nah. II, 5</cite> <he>ברקין ט׳</he>, v. preced.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:2">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הכא ט׳</he> in the one case his mind is preoccupied.
<cite ref="Eruvin 68a:3">Erub. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>טְרִידְנָא בגירסאי</he> I am engrossed in my studies.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>דהות טריד</he> (or <he>דטְרִידַת</he>; Ms. F., <cite ref="I00783"><he>טְרִיחַת</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) that thou wert troubled (in my behalf); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 917">Yalk. Job 917</cite> [read:] <he>חמית דטרידת וכ׳</he>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:24">Targ. Y. Gen. III, 24</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:5">Targ. Prov. XXV, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 27:45">Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 45</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Berakhot 35b">Ber. 35ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 863:7">Yalk. Deut. 863</cite> <he>דלא תִיטַּרְדּוּ וכ׳</he> that you may not be troubled about support &c.
<cite ref="Arakhin 16b:75">Arakh. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>אתי לאִיטְּרוּדֵי</he> he may get into a quarrel.
